item.title: Readout of Secretary of War Pete Hegseth's Meeting With Poland's Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of National Defense Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz
item.description: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth met with Poland's Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of National Defense Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz at the Pentagon.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: The Department of War's Office of Strategic Capital Signs $150 Million Conditional Loan Commitment With Rocket Lab
item.description: The War Department's Office of Strategic Capital announced a $150 million conditional loan commitment with Rocket Lab USA Inc. to support Rocket Lab's efforts to increase the flight rate of its reusable Neutron rocket beyond first launch to meet growing commercial and national security demand for access to space.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations

item.title: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth Orders Sweeping Overhaul of Military Education to Refocus on Combat Lethality
item.description: In a major move to restore a culture of accountability and warfighting excellence, Secretary of War Pete Hegseth directed the comprehensive overhaul of the Department's Professional Military Education system.
item.dc:creator: Press Operations
